name: manual_fc6e82
claim: For intra-machine multi-agent coordination (concurrent Claude Code/kimi/cline sessions in different git worktrees on the same machine), reuse orchestrator/GossipBus (SQLite FTS5 event log) as a claim/registration board instead of building new infrastructure — it is already intra-machine by design (zero LAN dependency). The only real problem is db-path resolution across worktrees, solved via 'git rev-parse --git-common-dir' (every worktree of the same repo resolves to the same shared .git dir, zero new env vars needed).
conditions: concurrent agents same machine git worktree coordination claim collision GossipBus intra-machine

decisions.notes: 2026-07-11: two Claude Code sessions worked the same PT repo simultaneously (this session + a concurrent worktree implementing Phase 1-4 of the self-healing-mesh plan). Collision was avoided only by manual git-log/ps-aux archaeology before every dispatch. Built scripts/agent_coordination.py on this pattern; the concurrent session then independently extended it with heartbeat/liveness monitoring — validates the reuse-not-rebuild approach.
